newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coates says can achieve forecast profit.
newsitem.headline: Coates says can achieve forecast profit.

text.p: Coates Hire Ltd said on Thursday that it was confident of achieving its full year prospectus net profit of A$13.3 million.

"Unless we have some unknown problem in the next six weeks we believe we can achieve our full year prospectus forecast," Coates managing director Jim Brown told a Securities Institute of Australia seminar.

Brown said the company saw its best growth prospects from the access equipment hire business and from the Indonesian market where the company expected to earn 15 percent of its profit by the year 2000.
"Overall we have a good outlook for continuous profitable growth," he said.
The company posted a half year net profit of A$6.61 million to December 31.
It was listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in August last year after being sold by heavy engineering group Australian National Industries Ltd as a non-core asset.
